categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: electronic payment password systems for bank note anti-counterfeiting, bank corporate business digital platforms (Yinqitong), and paper texture anti-counterfeiting technology for product traceability. The traditional electronic payment password system remains the main revenue source, while the company is actively developing and promoting paper texture anti-counterfeiting technology and maintaining innovation in bank digital transformation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include electronic payment password systems and password chips, a bank corporate business platform (Yinqitong), and proprietary paper texture anti-cloning technology based on Physically Unclonable Functions (PUF). The paper texture technology leverages unique paper fiber structures combined with AI for authentication, offering a low-cost, highly secure anti-counterfeiting solution. The company employs internal R&D, strict quality management systems (ISO9001, CMMI), and microservices architecture for software development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are major banks across China, including their corporate clients and large financial institutions. The company also targets industries requiring product anti-counterfeiting and traceability such as tobacco, alcohol, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and e-commerce sectors. The bank note anti-counterfeiting products serve the financial sector, while paper texture technology aims at broader commercial product traceability markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales in northern and southern regions. It has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong responsible for overseas business development, technology cooperation, and investment. The company’s products and services cover nationwide banking institutions and select large enterprises.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and sales of security hardware and software products for banks and commercial clients. It also provides digital platforms and anti-counterfeiting solutions, positioning itself as a technology provider and system integrator rather than a raw material supplier or end consumer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include cost and expense control, focusing on new business breakthroughs especially in paper texture anti-counterfeiting technology for product traceability, and deepening value in bank digital transformation services. R&D efforts emphasize innovation in paper texture PUF technology, building scalable SaaS and PaaS platforms, and developing intelligent terminal devices for diverse application scenarios. The company aims to balance innovation investment with operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic payment password systems, software platform services (Yinqitong), and paper texture anti-counterfeiting systems and devices. The company also earns income from leasing its own real estate properties and investment returns from financial assets. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales and some agency sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the electronic payment password system market for bank note anti-counterfeiting, holding a dominant market share with stable competitive positioning. It faces competition in emerging product lines such as paper texture anti-counterfeiting and bank digital platforms but leverages proprietary technology and longstanding banking relationships as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 128 million, a decline of 11.41% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 48.1 million, though the loss narrowed by 29.83%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 608 million with a low debt ratio of 3.06%. R&D expenses remain significant but have decreased, reflecting a strategic focus on cost control. Cash flow from operations turned positive compared to the prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique paper texture anti-cloning technology that exploits the natural, immutable fiber structure of paper combined with AI recognition, offering a highly secure, cost-effective anti-counterfeiting solution that is difficult to replicate. Its longstanding expertise and certification in bank note anti-counterfeiting provide irreplaceable security infrastructure for financial institutions. The integrated digital platform for bank corporate services supports banks’ digital transformation with tailored, scenario-based solutions.
